en.gameDesc: Solve counting problems using permutations, combinations, the multiplication principle, and arrangements with repetition. Select or type your answer and check if you're right!

af.gameDesc: Los telprobleme op met permutasies, kombinasies, die vermenigvuldigingsbeginsel, en rangskikkings met herhaling. Kies of tik jou antwoord in en kyk of jy reg is!

zu.gameDesc: Xazulula izinkinga zokubala usebenzisa amaphermutheshini, amakombineshini, umthetho wokuphindaphinda, nokuhlela ngokuphindaphinda. Khetha noma uthayiphe impendulo yakho bese uhlola ukuthi ulungile!
